title: Lyrebird: a physically interpretable syllable inventory for 2,650 wild bird species, with the recordist-blocked evaluation that bounds it
description:
Derived data and code for the Lyrebird project: a physically interpretable syllable inventory built from wild bird recordings, and a measurement of what a recordist-blocked evaluation split costs a bioacoustic foundation model.

Contents. Frozen Perch 2.0 (1536-d) and BirdNET V2.4 (1024-d) embeddings for a fixed population of xeno-canto recordings uploaded after both models' training snapshots; the recordist and species metadata for that population; the complete post-cutoff catalogue so the population can be reconstructed; the JSON result sidecar of every pre-registered gate the project ran; and both manuscripts.

No audio is included. The recordings belong to the xeno-canto and iNaturalist contributors under per-recording licences that cannot be sublicensed. The pipeline decodes each recording, describes it as numbers, and deletes it. Everything here is non-invertible derived features and metadata, which is what makes the release possible at all. The catalogue records exactly which recordings were used, so anyone can re-fetch them from the source under the contributors' own terms.

Reproduction. Every number is produced by a script that prints its pre-registered gate before its result. See pipeline/analysis/README.md.
